title: Independent task spawning and result collection
prompt_template:
You are writing code for {{RUNTIME_NAME}}.

Use the provided local documentation excerpts as the primary context. Treat these links as metadata/citation only:
- Repository: {{RUNTIME_REPO_URL}}
- Documentation: {{RUNTIME_DOCS_URL}}

Task:
Write a complete {{LANGUAGE_NAME}} program that launches 4 independent units of work, each computing the sum of one array, then collects the 4 sums.

Requirements:
1) Generate or define 4 Float32-compatible arrays.
2) Execute the 4 sums through the runtime's task model (not purely sequential loops).
3) Collect all 4 results and verify correctness against a serial reference.
4) Print exactly PASS on the last line if checks pass; otherwise print FAIL.
5) Exit successfully on PASS.

Output rules:
- Return only a single fenced code block tagged {{CODE_FENCE_LANG}}.
- Include no explanation outside the code block.
